const payload = $json.body && typeof $json.body === 'object' ? { ...$json.body, ...$json } : $json;
return [{ json: { ...payload, title: String(payload.title ?? '').trim(), description: String(payload.description ?? '').trim() } }];

if (!$json.title || !$json.description) throw new Error('Ticket title and description are required');
return [{ json: { ...$json, validation: { valid: true, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() } } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, ticketId: String($json.ticketId ?? ('TCK-' + Date.now())), status: String($json.status ?? 'Open'), workflowTrace: Array.isArray($json.workflowTrace) ? $json.workflowTrace : [], stepTrace: Array.isArray($json.stepTrace) ? $json.stepTrace : [] } }];

const allowed=['Network','Hardware','Software','Account & Access','Security','Other']; const category=allowed.includes($json.category)?$json.category:'Other'; return [{ json: { ...$json, category } }];

const category = $json.category || 'Other'; const priority = $json.priority || 'Medium'; const baseTeams = { Network: 'Network Support', Hardware: 'Hardware Support', Software: 'Software Support', 'Account & Access': 'Identity and Access Support', Security: 'Security Operations', Other: 'IT General' }; let team = $json.assignedTeam || baseTeams[category] || baseTeams.Other; if (priority === 'Critical' || priority === 'High') { if (category === 'Security') team = 'Security Operations (Tier 2 Incident Response)'; else if (category === 'Network' || category === 'Hardware') team = 'Infrastructure Operations (Tier 2)'; else team = 'Senior IT Support Team'; } return [{ json: { ...$json, assignedTeam: team } }];

const priority = $json.priority || 'Medium'; const baseQueues = { Network: 'queue-network', Hardware: 'queue-hardware', Software: 'queue-software', 'Account & Access': 'queue-access', Security: 'queue-security', Other: 'queue-general' }; let queue = baseQueues[$json.category] || baseQueues.Other; if (priority === 'Critical' || priority === 'High') { queue = queue + '-escalated'; } return [{ json: { ...$json, assignmentQueue: queue } }];

const priority = $json.priority || 'Medium'; const isEscalated = priority === 'Critical' || priority === 'High'; const reason = `Routed by category: ${$json.category}${isEscalated ? ' (Escalated tier for ' + priority + ' priority)' : ' (Standard L1 queue)'}`; return [{ json: { ...$json, assignmentReason: reason } }];

const currentHour = new Date().getHours(); const isAfterHours = currentHour < 8 || currentHour >= 18; return [{ json: { ...$json, assignment: { team: $json.assignedTeam, queue: $json.assignmentQueue, assigned: Boolean($json.assignedTeam), shift: isAfterHours ? 'After-hours / On-call' : 'Standard Business Hours', assignedAt: new Date().toISOString() } } }];

const workflowId = $workflow.name.match(/^WF\d+/)?.[0] ?? 'WF';
return [{ json: { ...$json, workflowTrace: [...new Set([...($json.workflowTrace ?? []), workflowId])], stepTrace: [...($json.stepTrace ?? []), 'workflow-complete'] } }];
return [{ json: { ...$json, workflowResult: { workflow: $workflow.name, ticketId: $json.ticketId, processedAt: new Date().toISOString(), success: true } } }];
